description: This file contains a sample PHP client implementation for interacting with the TestLink API via XML-RPC. It defines functions for executing test cases and preparing RPC data, and includes sample usage demonstrating how to report a test case result.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Prepares and executes an XML-RPC call to report a test case result to the TestLink server, wrapping data collection, error handling, and response retrieval.
